next_changelog: Updated [Decision Procedure]: added a format-alignment validation and repair pass that detects candidates which would split orthographic or morphological units, shifts such offending cuts to the nearest safe preceding boundary (or removes them if no safe boundary exists), and requires a final simulation that removing tags reproduces the original input exactly — this prevents tag-inside-word format errors while preserving generous candidate marking.

next_changelog: [When to Segment]: Clarified how predicate/auxiliary/modality and subject-disambiguating cues affect the renderability judgment; listed concrete surface forms that typically indicate continuation and must be treated as marginally renderable (still candidates but lower confidence). This reduces premature commits before main verbs, auxiliaries, or disambiguating particles.

[Decision Procedure]: Added a mandatory re-ranking pass that demotes candidates whose preceding stretch ends in connective/continuation suffixes or lacks clause-final verb/auxiliary/modal markers, and that demotes cuts which would leave an immediately-following multiword named-entity or list fragment unresolved. This enforces lower priority for risky placements without forbidding them.
